messages.content:
A reader of a contract claims that the quoted passages below settle a statement (the hypothesis). You do not see the contract; judge only from the quotes.

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
</hypothesis>

<claimed_label>
Entailment
</claimed_label>

<quotes>
<quote>Clause 5.1 of this Agreement shall not apply to:</quote>
<quote>Copies of Confidential Information which must be retained by the Receiving Party pursuant to applicable law.</quote>
</quotes>

The labels mean:
- Entailment: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is false.

Decide whether the quotes, taken as written, are enough on their own to support the claimed label. Answer supports = false if the quotes are about something else, support the opposite label, support only part of the hypothesis, or need context the quotes do not give.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: supports (true or false) and a one-sentence reason.

content.text: {"supports": true, "reason": "The quotes exempt copies of Confidential Information that the Receiving Party must retain under applicable law from the clause 5.1 obligation (evidently the return/destruction duty), which clearly implies some information may be retained afterward."}
